dog.description_text:
Meet Iggy!

Iggy is a sweet boy with a curious side and a love for the simple things in life! He enjoys taking in the world around him, watching all the interesting things happening nearby, and seeing what each day has in store.

When it’s time for fun, Iggy enjoys playtime and is always happy when yummy treats are involved! He’s the perfect companion for someone who appreciates a dog who enjoys observing the world and sharing little moments together.

If you’re looking for a sweet companion to enjoy treats, playtime, and plenty of people watching adventures with, Iggy is ready to meet you!

*You can meet animals located at the ASPCA Adoption Center during our walk-in hours (daily, noon to 5 p.m.). We encourage a $150 suggested adoption fee when adopting an animal. This adoption fee allows the ASPCA to continue our lifesaving work and help even more animals in need. We are grateful for any amount given at the time of adoption.*
